Overview

Rumelange is a city in Esch-sur-Alzette Canton with a population of 5,600. A southern Luxembourg town with a proud mining heritage, home to the National Mining Museum and surrounded by the scenic Red Lands region. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
